Read the [canonical workflow](https://github.com/HallelujahHomeChurch/hhc-planning/blob/73ee1af2a1ff828d72421a73626f45ff4ce04a6f/workflow/v1/WORKFLOW.md) and [skill](https://github.com/HallelujahHomeChurch/hhc-planning/blob/73ee1af2a1ff828d72421a73626f45ff4ce04a6f/skills/hhc-delivery/SKILL.md) at the task's recorded planning revision.
Keep public entries generic and sanitized; private requirements/member content/notes/raw sensitive logs stay out of public Git history. Duplicate/cancellation closure is not delivery.
